practiceReport.name: B.J. Green II
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 3); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Green has strung together six consecutive full practices since being designated to return from injured reserve Nov. 11. He's not quite ready to be activated from IR, so his next chance to play is Week 12 against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 29. Green is in the final stages of his recovery from an elbow injury that he suffered in Week 1 against the Browns.

factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (82%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Jones suffered a chest injury early in the first half, and his night has now officially come to a premature end. The Jaguars will now have to operate without their top slot cornerback for the stretch run versus New York.

practiceReport.name: Travon Walker
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (76% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Walker was a full participant in Friday's practice, and that was enough for the fifth-year defensive end to avoid an injury tag heading into Sunday's contest. The 2022 first-rounder has 22 tackles (10 solo), including 3.0 sacks, and two pass defenses through nine regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Antonio Johnson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (87% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Johnson was a limited participant in all three Week 11 practices, but the 2023 fifth-rounder has done enough to avoid an injury tag ahead of Sunday's contest. Johnson has accumulated 40 tackles (23 solo), including 1.5 sacks, and one pass defense across eight regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.
